 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 03.02.2026 CRL.M.A. 3632/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 539/2024 of Police Station Prem Nagar for offence under Section 498A IPC (85 BNS)/406 IPC (316 BNS)/34 IPC (3(5) BNS) on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP for State assisted by IO/ASI Bhupinder Singh accepts notice and seeks and is allowed four weeks to file status report in view of the allegation in the FIR regarding forcible abortion.
4. Respondent no.2 identified by the IO accepts notice.
5. Awaiting the status report, relist on 12.05.2026 in Advance List.
